views.name: customer_monthly_changes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS month,
    SUM(amount) AS payment_amount,
    SUM(amount) - LAG(SUM(amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date)) AS monthly_change
FROM payment
GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date)
views.description: payment records ordered by customer and month with the difference between current and previous month's payment amounts

views.name: avg_monthly_change_per_customer
views.body_sql:
SELECT customer_id, AVG(monthly_change) AS avg_monthly_change
FROM customer_monthly_changes
GROUP BY customer_id
views.description: average of the monthly payment changes grouped by customer
